newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Japan trade official sees no big swings in surplus.
newsitem.headline: Japan trade official sees no big swings in surplus.

text.p: Japan's trade surplus is not likely to show any big swings either up or down next year, Japan's Vice Trade Minister for International Affairs Hisashi Hosokawa said on Friday.

"I can't tell you the official figure or estimate but I personally anticipate that the decrease, if any, or increase, if any, will be minimal," Hosokawa told Reuters Financial Television. "I do not foresee major upswings or major downswings."
Hosokawa is here for the World Trade Organisation's (WTO) first ministerial meeting, which ended on Friday.
Data released on Wednesday showed Japan"s current account surplus shrank again in October but at a slower pace, and analysts predicted the figure would begin to rise again sometime next year.
